timing: Post hoc validation correction after the first observed preemption; registered before N=30 or additional-cohort blocks completed.

trigger.original_failure: Wrong output lengths or request preemption

reason: A real request preemption under memory pressure is an observed policy outcome, not a failed request or permission to rerun until preemption disappears. The original zero-preemption condition was overly restrictive for the load sweep.
acceptance_change: Keep actual nonnegative integer preemption counts, retain every prescribed policy/run, and enforce all request-integrity, token-length, configuration, counter-coverage, source, package, model, and hardware checks.
accounting_correction: The server request_prefill_kv_computed histogram is derived from completed-request prompt-minus-cached usage. Report it as reported_uncached_prompt_tokens; extra prefill work due to preemption is unmeasured and must not be called exact executed or redundant computation.
